[[File:Stinger-FF137.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Guri]]'s ''[[Stinger]]'' was a Surronian assault ship]]
'''Assault ship''' was a generic term used to describe myriad [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] scale vehicles meant for use in an offensive capacity. For example, the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator'' class]] was referred to as an assault ship,<ref name="AOTCICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> as was the [[All Terrain Rapid Deployment Pod]],<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> which was small enough to fit hundreds within a ship similar to the ''Acclamator''.<ref name="JO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> They could be used to carry troops or aircraft into combat situations and support their landing operations. Some assault ship designs were small enough to be used similar to [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding craft]], attaching to larger space vessels with boarding troops inside.
